text.zh: 巅峰期一次重伤，主刀医生摇了摇头：「你可能……再也回不到从前了。」
text.en: A serious injury at your peak. The surgeon shakes his head: 'You may… never be the same again.'

label.zh: 魔鬼般的复健，我一定王者归来
label.en: Punishing rehab — you will come back stronger

note.zh: 致敬大罗两次重伤后的王者归来
note.en: Ronaldo's comebacks from two career-threatening injuries

background.zh: 大罗两次膝盖重伤几乎断送生涯，却两度王者归来，并在 2002 年世界杯加冕——足坛最励志的复出之一。
background.en: Ronaldo's two devastating knee injuries nearly ended his career; he came back twice and was crowned at the 2002 World Cup — one of football's great comebacks.

label.zh: 改打更省力的位置，用智慧延长生涯
label.en: Drop into an easier role and extend your career with guile

label.zh: 从此一蹶不振，状态再也没回来
label.en: Never recover — the form simply never returns

label.zh: 算了，直接退役，回家开个酒庄
label.en: Forget it — retire early and open a vineyard
